summary: Firefox improved video and audio decoding performance and reliability across different platforms by enhancing hardware-accelerated decoding using Vulkan (the technology that lets Firefox offload video decoding to AMD, Intel, and NVIDIA GPUs) and platform-specific decoders like Apple's Video Toolbox. The work also made Firefox better at querying which video formats like VP9 and AV1 can run in hardware, improved how it protects copyrighted content when decoding, and added audio encoding support to match the wider codec ecosystem.
